Winsome Glam began with a simple frustration: everything beautiful was either disposable or unaffordable. So we set out to make the third thing pieces with the weight, plating and finish of fine jewellery, priced so you can wear them on a Tuesday.

Thicker plating

2.5 micron gold vermeil over a hypoallergenic base five times the industry minimum, so colour stays true through daily wear.

Small batches

We make forty to sixty pairs of a design at a time. If something does not meet the bar at final polish, it does not ship.

Honest pricing

No seasonal markups to discount later. One price, held all year, wherever in the world you order from.

Shipping policy

At Winsome Glam, we carefully prepare and package every order to ensure your jewelry reaches you safely and beautifully.

Please review our shipping information below before placing your order.

Order Processing

Standard orders are normally processed within 1–3 working days.

Personalised, engraved and made-to-order jewellery may require additional preparation time. The estimated processing time for these products will be stated on the relevant product page.

Orders placed on weekends or UK public holidays will begin processing on the next working day.

Processing time is separate from delivery time.

UK Delivery

We offer delivery throughout the United Kingdom.

Standard UK Delivery: 4-5 working days.

Express UK Delivery: 2-3 working days.

Available delivery methods and charges will be displayed at checkout before payment is completed.

Delivery estimates begin once your order has been dispatched.

Unless a different delivery period has been agreed with you, orders will be delivered within the timeframe required by applicable UK consumer law.

International Delivery

We may also deliver to selected international destinations.

Estimated international delivery times and available shipping services will be shown at checkout where applicable.

International orders may be subject to:

Customs duties

Import taxes

Handling charges

Other fees imposed by the destination country

Unless expressly stated otherwise at checkout, these charges are the responsibility of the customer and are not included in the product or delivery price.

Customs procedures may occasionally delay international deliveries.

Order Tracking

Where tracking is available, you will receive a dispatch confirmation containing your tracking information.

Please allow some time after dispatch for the courier's tracking system to update.

Delivery Addresses

Please check your delivery details carefully before completing your order.

Customers are responsible for providing a complete and accurate delivery address.

If you notice an error after placing your order, contact us immediately at info@winsomeglamorous.com.

We will make reasonable efforts to update the address before dispatch, but we cannot guarantee changes once an order has entered processing or has been handed to the courier.

Incorrect or Incomplete Addresses

If an order is returned to us because an incorrect or incomplete address was provided, we will contact you to arrange redelivery where possible.

Additional delivery charges may apply where the delivery failure resulted from incorrect address information supplied at checkout.

Delayed Orders

Delivery estimates are provided in good faith, but occasional delays can occur due to circumstances outside our reasonable control, including:

Courier disruption

Severe weather

Customs processing

Public holidays

Industrial action

High seasonal demand

If your order has not arrived within the expected delivery period, please contact us at info@winsomeglamorous.com with your order number.

We will investigate the shipment with the delivery provider.

Lost Orders

If tracking indicates that your parcel may have been lost, please contact us as soon as possible.

We will investigate the matter with the courier and, where appropriate, arrange a replacement or refund in accordance with your legal rights.

Customers will not be expected to resolve a genuine lost-delivery claim directly with a courier where responsibility for delivery remains with us.

Damaged Parcels

If your parcel arrives visibly damaged, please take photographs of:

The outer packaging

Shipping label

Internal packaging

Damaged product

Contact us at info@winsomeglamorous.com as soon as reasonably possible and include your order number and photographs.

We will review the issue and arrange an appropriate resolution.

Multiple Parcels

Orders containing several items may occasionally be dispatched in separate parcels.

If this happens, you may receive more than one tracking number and your items may arrive at different times.

Personalised & Made-to-Order Jewellery

Personalised, engraved or made-to-order pieces may have longer processing times than standard products.

Any applicable production timeframe will be displayed on the product page or communicated to you before dispatch.

Please remember that processing time is additional to the estimated delivery time.

Delivery Responsibility

Your order remains our responsibility until it is delivered to you, or to another person identified by you to receive it, subject to applicable consumer law.

Contact Us

If you have any questions regarding shipping or an existing order, please contact:

Winsome Glam

This policy is designed to comply with applicable UK data protection laws, including the UK GDPR, the Data Protection Act 2018 and, where applicable, the Privacy and Electronic Communications Regulations.

1. Who We Are

For the purposes of UK data protection law, the data controller is:

Legal Business Name: Winsome Glam
Business Address: Victoria Street Bangor Gwynned Wales United Kingdom LL572HD
Email: info@winsomeglamorous.com

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or how your personal information is handled, please contact us using the details above.

Your name

Email address

Telephone number

Order and transaction information

Products purchased or viewed

Account information, where accounts are available

Communications you send to us

IP address

Website usage and interaction data

Cookie and consent preferences

Marketing preferences

Information required for personalized products, such as names, dates or engraving text

Payment information is normally processed securely by our authorized payment providers. We do not generally receive or store complete debit or credit card details.

3. How We Collect Your Information

Directly from you when you place an order

When you create an account

When you subscribe to marketing communications

When you contact customer service

When you submit product personalization details

Automatically through cookies and similar technologies

From payment, delivery, fraud-prevention and ecommerce service providers where necessary to fulfil an order or operate our business

4. How We Use Your Personal Information

We may use your personal information to:

Process and fulfil orders

Take and verify payments

Arrange delivery

Send order confirmations and delivery updates

Process returns, exchanges and refunds

Produce personalized or engraved products

Respond to enquiries and customer service requests

Prevent fraud and protect our website

Maintain accounting, tax and business records

Improve our website, products and customer experience

Analyse website performance

Send marketing communications where legally permitted

Comply with our legal and regulatory obligations

5. Our Lawful Bases for Processing

Depending on the purpose, we process personal data because:

Contract: Processing is necessary to accept, manage and fulfil your order.

Legal Obligation: We may need to retain or process information to comply with tax, accounting, consumer protection or other legal requirements.

Legitimate Interests: We may process information where necessary for legitimate business purposes, such as fraud prevention, website security, customer service and improving our services, provided these interests do not override your rights.

Consent: We rely on consent where required, including for certain marketing communications and non-essential cookies. You may withdraw your consent at any time.

6. Marketing Communications

Where permitted by law, we may send you information about products, promotions, launches or offers.

We will only send electronic marketing where we have an appropriate legal basis under applicable UK rules.

You can unsubscribe at any time by:

Clicking the unsubscribe link in a marketing email; or

Contacting us at [SUPPORT EMAIL].

Withdrawing marketing consent will not affect essential transactional communications relating to an existing order.

7. Cookies and Similar Technologies

Our website uses cookies and similar technologies.

Some cookies are strictly necessary for functions such as:

Shopping baskets

Checkout

Security

Payment processing

Remembering essential website preferences

We may also use analytics, advertising or personalization cookies.

Where legally required, non-essential cookies will not be activated until you provide consent through our cookie consent tool.

You can change or withdraw your cookie preferences using the cookie settings available on our website.

8. Who We Share Information With

We may share personal information only where reasonably necessary with trusted service providers, including:

Ecommerce and website providers

Payment processors

Banks and payment networks

Delivery and courier companies

Order fulfilment providers

Email and communications providers

Analytics providers

Advertising platforms where you have provided appropriate consent

IT, hosting and security providers

Professional advisers such as accountants or legal advisers

Government bodies or law enforcement agencies where legally required

These parties are permitted to use personal information only in accordance with applicable law and their contractual responsibilities.

We do not sell your personal information to third parties.

9. International Data Transfers

Some of our service providers may process personal information outside the United Kingdom.

Where personal information is transferred internationally, we take appropriate steps to ensure the transfer is lawful and that suitable safeguards are used where required under UK data protection law.

10. How Long We Keep Your Information

We retain personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes for which it was collected, including fulfilling legal, tax, accounting, fraud prevention and contractual requirements.

Refund policy

At Winsome Glam, we want you to be completely satisfied with your jewelry.

This policy explains how cancellations, returns and refunds are handled. Nothing in this policy limits or excludes your statutory rights under UK consumer law.

Change-of-Mind Returns

For most eligible products purchased online, you may cancel your order within 14 days beginning the day after you receive your goods.

You do not need to provide a reason for cancelling.

To exercise your right to cancel, please contact us within the 14-day cancellation period at:

info@winsomeglamorous.com

Please provide:

Your name

Order number

Product(s) you wish to return

A clear statement confirming that you wish to cancel your purchase

After notifying us that you wish to cancel, eligible goods must normally be returned within a further 14 days.

Return Address

Eligible returns should be sent to:

RETURN ADDRESS:Victoria Street Bangor Gwynned Wales United Kingdom LL572HD

Please do not send a return before contacting us and receiving the appropriate return instructions.

We strongly recommend using a tracked postal service and keeping proof of postage until your refund has been completed.

Return Condition

You may inspect an item in the same way you reasonably would in a physical shop.

Where possible, returned products should include:

Original packaging

Jewellery box or pouch

Accessories

Certificates

Any other components supplied with the item

You may be responsible for any reduction in value caused by handling beyond what is reasonably necessary to inspect the product.

Personalised & Custom-Made Jewellery

Products that are made to your specification or clearly personalised are generally excluded from statutory change-of-mind cancellation rights.

This may include:

Engraved jewellery

Custom names or initials

Personalised dates or messages

Bespoke designs

Certain products specifically manufactured to your individual requirements

Please check all personalisation information carefully before completing your order.

Personalised products remain protected where they are faulty, damaged, incorrectly personalised by us or otherwise not as described.

Earrings & Hygiene

Certain earrings or pierced jewellery may be supplied in sealed hygiene packaging.

Where a product is sealed for health protection or hygiene reasons and is not suitable for return once unsealed, change-of-mind cancellation rights may cease after the seal has been broken.

Please therefore inspect any hygiene-sealed jewellery carefully before opening the seal.

This does not affect your statutory rights where an item is faulty, damaged or not as described.

Faulty, Damaged or Incorrect Items

Under UK consumer law, products must be:

Of satisfactory quality

Fit for purpose

As described

If your jewellery arrives faulty, damaged or different from what you ordered, please contact us at info@winsomeglamorous.com.

Please include:

Your order number

Description of the issue

Clear photographs or video where reasonably appropriate

Depending on the circumstances and your statutory rights, an appropriate remedy may include:

Refund

Replacement

Repair

Price reduction

If we require a faulty or incorrect product to be returned, reasonable return costs will be covered where required by law.

30-Day Right to Reject Faulty Goods

Where applicable under the Consumer Rights Act 2015, consumers may have a short-term right to reject qualifying faulty goods and request a refund within the statutory period.

Additional rights may continue beyond this period, including rights to repair or replacement where applicable.

Nothing in this policy reduces these statutory rights.

Return Shipping Costs

For ordinary change-of-mind returns, customers are responsible for the direct cost of returning the item unless we have expressly agreed otherwise.

Where an item is faulty, damaged, incorrect or otherwise does not conform to the contract, return costs will be handled in accordance with applicable UK consumer law.

Refunds

Once an eligible return has been received and inspected, we will process the applicable refund.

For statutory change-of-mind cancellations, refunds will normally include:

The price paid for the eligible returned products; and

The cost of the least expensive standard delivery method offered for the original order, where required by law

If you selected express, premium or enhanced delivery, the additional cost above our standard delivery option does not normally have to be refunded.

Refunds will be made using the original payment method unless otherwise agreed.

Where goods need to be returned, we may withhold the refund until we receive the goods back or you provide evidence that they have been returned, whichever occurs first where applicable.

Refunds will be issued within the timeframe required by UK consumer law.

Please allow additional time for your bank or payment provider to process the refunded amount after it has been issued.

Exchanges

If you would like to exchange an eligible item for another:

Size

Finish

Colour

Style

please contact us at info@winsomeglamorous.com.

Exchanges are subject to product availability and return eligibility.

For some orders, the quickest option may be to return the original eligible product for a refund and place a new order.

Personalised products cannot normally be exchanged simply because you change your mind.

Natural Materials

Some of our jewellery may contain natural materials such as:

Freshwater pearls

Mother of pearl

Moss agate

Natural stones

Shell

Other naturally occurring materials

Natural variations in colour, shape, markings, texture and pattern are part of the individual character of these materials and do not automatically constitute a fault.

Normal Wear & Jewelry Care

Jewelry can naturally experience changes over time depending on wear and exposure to:

Water

Perfume

Cosmetics

Chemicals

Perspiration

Cleaning products

Improper storage

Damage resulting from misuse, accidents, excessive wear or failure to follow reasonable jewelry care instructions may not constitute a manufacturing fault.

Your statutory rights remain unaffected where a product was faulty when supplied.

Gifts

Refunds are normally returned to the original payment method used to place the order.

If you received an item as a gift, please contact us and we will explain the options available.

How to Request a Return

Email info@winsomeglamorous.com with:

Reason for Return:

Our customer support team will provide the appropriate return instructions.

pages.title: Our story – Winsome Glam
headings: Fine jewellery lost the plot. We wanted the feeling back.
pages.text:
OUR STORY
Fine jewellery lost the plot. We wanted the feeling back.

Winsome Glam began with a simple frustration: everything beautiful was either disposable or unaffordable. So we set out to make the third thing pieces with the weight, plating and finish of fine jewellery, priced so you can wear them on a Tuesday.

Thicker plating

2.5 micron gold vermeil over a hypoallergenic base five times the industry minimum, so colour stays true through daily wear.

Small batches

We make forty to sixty pairs of a design at a time. If something does not meet the bar at final polish, it does not ship.

Honest pricing

No seasonal markups to discount later. One price, held all year, wherever in the world you order from.
